name: Price By Location
author: FuturisticIT

sections.description:
Price by Location plugin for WooCommerce allows you to set different prices for products based on the customer’s location. This plugin uses geolocation to determine the customer’s location and display the appropriate price for each product.

Features:

  • Country based pricing
  • State based pricing
  • Postcode based pricing
  • Automatic geolocation detection
  • Easy price management

This plugin helps store owners create localized pricing strategies for different regions.

External Services

This plugin connects to the IPInfo and IPGeolocation APIs to detect visitor geolocation for country-based pricing.

Data sent:
– Visitor IP address

When data is sent:
– During frontend page loads when geolocation detection is enabled.

Services used:

IPInfo
Terms: https://ipinfo.io/terms-of-service
Privacy: https://ipinfo.io/privacy-policy

IP-API
Used to detect visitor geolocation from IP addresses.

Website:
https://ip-api.io/

Privacy Policy:
https://ipapi.org/privacy.php

IPGeolocation
Terms: https://ipgeolocation.io/tos.html
Privacy: https://ipgeolocation.io/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/price-by-location directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce settings to configure geo pricing rules.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

Can I set prices by postcode?

Yes, you can create pricing rules based on postcode ranges.

Does it support variable products?

Yes, the plugin supports simple and variable products.
